title: Personal Credit Cards: reversing a late fee on a card that carried autopay
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: ground for reversing a late fee on an autopay card

This entry covers the Personal Credit Cards line of Piedmont Crescent Bank. A policy decides the ground on which a late payment fee is reversed when the card carried an automatic payment instruction, and this entry is also the invocation reference for the internal tool reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c.

## What the policy governs

- **Situation:** a late payment fee on a Personal Credit Cards account that carried an automatic payment instruction.
- **Result it decides:** the ground for reversing that fee, which is either the bank error ground, for a fee billed contrary to the charter, or no ground under this policy.
- **Handling effect:** a reversal is always for the full amount of the fee, posted as one fee reversal linked to that fee.

## How the tool is invoked

reverse_autopay_late_fee_e77f172c is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): the agent unlocks it with unlock_agent_discoverable_tool and calls it with call_agent_discoverable_tool. The agent performs the call; the cardholder does not run it.

## What one call does

One call reverses one billed late payment fee on a credit card account in full and records the ground for the reversal. It posts one fee-reversal credit entry on the card account, linked to the late fee it cancels and carrying the reversal ground, in the statement cycle that is open today. The card's current balance owed goes down by the reversed amount at once, and the cardholder sees the reversal credit on the card activity immediately and on the next statement. The tool itself checks no eligibility, status, window or amount: it books the values it is given.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the cardholder whose fee is reversed, as returned by the customer profile lookup | reference number text |
| card_account_id | the reference number of the credit card account that was billed the fee, as returned by the card account lookup | reference number text |
| source_item_id | the reference number of the late payment fee entry being reversed, as returned by the card activity lookup for that account | reference number text |
| amount | the amount reversed | USD, a positive number rounded half-up to 2 decimal places; never empty for this call |
| adjustment_reason | the ground on which the fee is reversed | exactly one of the values below |

Allowed values of adjustment_reason:

- bank_error: the fee was billed contrary to the card charter and is reversed without counting against any courtesy allowance.
- courtesy_waiver: the fee was billed correctly and is reversed as a courtesy that counts against the cardholder's rolling courtesy allowance.
- dispute_final: the fee was billed on a disputed charge whose billing dispute was resolved for the cardholder.
- none: no ground; never valid for a fee reversal and not to be used.
- dispute_provisional: a temporary billing-dispute credit ground; never valid for a fee reversal and not to be used.
- scra_benefit: a military rate cap interest ground; never valid for a fee reversal and not to be used.

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: status (always "reversed" when the posting succeeded), card_txn_id (the new fee-reversal entry), card_account_id, reversed_fee_id (the fee entry reversed), amount (USD, 2 decimal places), adjustment_reason (the ground recorded), statement_cycle (YYYY-MM), posted_date (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and new_current_balance (the balance owed after the reversal). The call is complete when this receipt comes back with status "reversed"; no other outcome is defined for the tool.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Can a late fee on an autopay card be reversed for part of its amount?**
A: No. The reversal is always for the full amount of the fee.
